notes.title: PAtch 0.82a - inventory reset
notes.content: [list][*][p]Added another safeguard for a rare inventory reset after restarting the game that some players are reporting.(if you lost your inventory, write me a DM so we can fix it).[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.82 - Pets, Performance and QoL
notes.content: [list][*][p][b]Added the Pet system[/b] - go on expeditions, find different rarity of eggs and hatch different pets. Level them up to get their bonuses higher[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Big performance optimization for the whole game[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Added 1 new talent to the chronomage to support it's AFK nature[/p][/*][*][p]Added another batch of steam achievements[/p][/*][*][p]Added another ascendancy bonus: kills threshold reduction(you need less kills to progress to next levels)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]                                                    [b][u]Inventory changes:[/u][/b][/p][list][*][p]Changed the starting inventory slots from 10 to 18[/p][/*][*][p]Added tags which you can press to only see the particular item types in the inventory[/p][/*][*][p]Added hover-over effect when hovering over items in the inventory[/p][/*][*][p]You can no longer delete equipped items[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]                                                    [b][u]UI changes:[/u][/b][/p][list][*][p]Full professional main screen UI re-work[/p][/*][*][p]You can now drag around most of the menus[/p][/*][*][p]Clicking on a menu brings it on top[/p][/*][*][p]Every menu closes with ESC button[/p][/*][*][p]Crafting panel now opens the crafting details on the right side instead of on top[/p][/*][*][p]Added confirmation window when trying to ascend[/p][/*][*][p]Buildings resource generated now shows: resource/second, resource/minute, resource/hour and tick[/p][/*][*][p]Changed notations from pure letters to E+X[/p][/*][*][p]Small tweaks in the expedition info UI[/p][/*][*][p]Added % of HP on enemies[/p][/*][*][p]Remade the first background's foliage/effects[/p][p][/p][p]                                             [b][u]Misc:[/u][/b][/p][/*][*][p]Keeping the current selected level is now moved to global saves(so you can continue via steam cloud on other devices)[/p][/*][*][p]Buffs to some expeditions % success rates and changes some timers[/p][p][/p][p]                                             [b][u]Fixes:[/u][/b][/p][/*][*][p]Fix for the game not always properly starting when not focused(for instance alt+tabbed)[/p][/*][*][p]Fix for weapons sometimes loosing their damage or reverting to level 1 damage[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed synergies properly applying when bulk buying follower levels[/p][/*][*][p]Another potential fix on workers not giving increases to buildings ~level 30-31[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the heavy stuttering when using consumables, especially using bags[/p][/*][*][p]A potential fix to ultra-wide monitors(please write feedback if it works or not)[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.81 - more QoL/Gold
notes.content: [list][*][p]Added Magical Coin as a rare drop[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the gold mine's global gold buff %[/p][/*][*][p]Gold mine now increases the yield of gold ore(from the ore mine)[/p][/*][*][p]Buffed the hunter camp(reaching cap is faster now, and you get more leather after cap)[/p][/*][*][p]Added offline progression for expeditions[/p][/*][*][p]Mute/unmute button for the music on the main menu screen[/p][/*][*][p]Craft "max" resources button when crafting a resource[/p][/*][*][p]Added arrows in the enemy info to go to the next/previous enemy[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the Hero UI, Followers UI with a new hand made UI.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][list][*][p]Fixed the katana recipe requiring 8/9 dragon slayer.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed workers not increasing resources at around level ~30 ish in lumber camp/quarry(now they will give overall more than before)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed un-equipping your weapon when trying to craft a new one and not having resources[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update 0.80
notes.content: [list][*][p]Improved soldiers system - each soldier gives % dmg, each threshold of soldiers add additional % dmg.[/p][/*][*][p]Training soldiers - you can get training manuals from expeditions and train your soldiers to give more % dmg[/p][/*][*][p]Buff to Ore Mine[/p][/*][*][p]Offline resource generation(the level you closed the game on will be the level you farm offline)[/p][/*][*][p]Borderless window mode[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update 0.79 - Workers and QoL
notes.content: [list][*][p]Added the workers system/Town Hall in the city.(you can now assign workers to the lumber camp or quarry to increase output)[/p][/*][*][p]Added an expedition to recruit new workers[/p][/*][*][p]Added 1 quest to get your first worker[/p][/*][*][p]Added inventory sorting: by gear, by resources.[/p][/*][*][p]Whetstone changed from giving 10 basic damage to giving 0.1% weapon damage[/p][/*][*][p]Added floating style popup text[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][list][*][p]Soldiers re-balancing[/p][/*][*][p]Moved game version in the main menu to the left side(so steam doesn't cover it)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed ring slot showing as neck when clicked[/p][/*][*][p]A small fix regarding weapon upgrading[/p][/*][*][p]Possible fix for players loosing expedition levels/xp[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 0.78.1 - a small performance patch
notes.content: [list][*][p]Added Vsync[/p][/*][*][p]Added fps cap/uncap[/p][/*][*][p]A button to remove all screen effects(if you need better performance while alt+tab)[/p][/*][*][p]Small rework to the auto-clicking mechanic.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update 0.78 - A big one
notes.content:
[list][*][p]Added a system to buy X amount of clickers at once(hold shift/ctrl/alt).[/p][/*][*][p]Gold mine now gives a global multiplier to gold gained for each lvl[/p][/*][*][p]City panel shows the building levels[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the text(resource gains) from neon green to dark green[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the ascendancy panel a bit with more info[/p][/*][*][p]A small rework on the audio manager(hopefully fixes the linux/proton issue)[/p][/*][*][p]2 more bag drops early on from quests[/p][/*][*][p]When you restart the game you go back to the level you were(no more starting from lvl 1 slime)[/p][/*][*][p]Expedition button on the main screen showing time left and clickable to go to the expedition[/p][/*][*][p]Hide completed achievements button[/p][/*][*][p]In the enemy info, when you look at an enemy you have a new button to go to that enemy level.[/p][/*][*][p]Potential fix to having visually 2 different levels of follower equipment, equipped.(only 1 should be active)[/p][/*][*][p]Unspent talents button on the main screen that leads you directly to the talents menu[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Nerfs:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Small nerf to followers/clickers gold cost and dmg[/p][/*][*][p]Small nerf to ascendancy bonuses[/p][/*][*][p]Buff to monster hp after level 200.
[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.77 - the QoL
notes.content: [list][*][p]Added auto-next level option[/p][/*][*][p]Centering on levels(now your level icon will try to be in the center)[/p][/*][*][p]Re-worked the lumber camp / quarry (you will get more resources now)[/p][/*][*][p]Soundtrack fix (sound will no longer reset on the same background if you just change to a higher enemy)[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the price of clickers[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 0.76.5 The long awaited remove armor button and city exit
notes.content: [list][*][p]added a system to be able to remove armor pieces from the inventory[/p][/*][*][p]added an exit button in the city panel[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 0.76.3 the un-clickable monsters
notes.content: [list][*][p]a fix for the few unclickable monsters in the range up to level 90(21 is still unclickable, that thing is unfixable.)[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 0.76.2 - Salvage improvement / Trader nerf
notes.content:
[list][*][p]Improved the salvage of items system(better UI and now you can salvage a % of your current resource)
[/p][/*][*][p]Nerfed the trader's first upgrade path a little as it was giving way too much damage early on.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 0.76.1 The bag + inventory overflow
notes.content:
[list][*][p]As per feedback added a very early quest to give you a bag.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some internal quest issues.[/p][/*][*][p]Inventory overflow fix - you no longer loose items if your inventory is full, rather they are saved and added back when your inventory has empty space.
[/p][/*][/list]

notes.content: [p]Trying a fix for the achievement spam some people are getting. Update your game.[/p]
